pairs.evidence: crates/server/src/e2e/panic_containment.rs:60 The panic regression relies on a persisted prose prefix to distinguish failure kinds, and the inspected worker/storage path does not preserve the structured panic outcome.

techniques.evidence: crates/server/src/e2e/error_contract.rs:145 The HTTP contract exposes and pins a machine-readable category for independently released clients.
